local.ansible:
- name: Update Wifi Broadcast
  ubiquiti.unifi_api.network:
    path: "/v1/sites/{siteId}/wifi/broadcasts/{wifiBroadcastId}"
    method: PUT
    body:
      basicDataRateKbpsByFrequencyGHz:
        '5': 6000
        '2.4': 2000
      blackoutScheduleConfiguration:
        days:
          - day: SUN
            type: string
      broadcastingDeviceFilter:
        type: string
      channel2gLockedTo6: true
      clientFilteringPolicy:
        action: ALLOW
        macAddressFilter:
          - string
      clientIsolationEnabled: true
      dtimPeriod2gLockedTo3: true
      enabled: true
      hideName: true
      mdnsProxyConfiguration:
        mode: string
      multicastFilteringPolicy:
        action: string
      multicastToUnicastConversionEnabled: true
      name: string
      network:
        type: string
      securityConfiguration:
        type: string
      type: string
      uapsdEnabled: true
  register: result


- debug:
    var: result.data
